description: Road Goods Vehicles Travelling to Mainland Europe is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. Bulletin giving quarterly statistics on the number of powered vehicles and unaccompanied trailers carried on each route to mainland Europe including Eurostar. Source agency: Transport Designation: National Statistics Language: English Alternative title: Road Goods Vehicles Travelling to Mainland Europe. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. It offers 16 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2014-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
